name: readme-presentation
body: README.md is presented as kalide's polished front page. At the top is a brand hero: the kalide mark (`brand/logo_light.svg` / `brand/logo_dark.svg`, switched via GitHub `<picture>` + `prefers-color-scheme`) with the name "kalide" as lowercase Helvetica-styled text. Headings, badges and sections are styled consistently. All existing technical content is retained, not cut: the install guide per install-docs, usage, CLI reference and table of contents. AC: README.md opens with a hero that references `brand/logo_dark.svg` and/or `brand/logo_light.svg`, both of which exist in the repo; the table of contents still resolves to every section; every install-docs step (token, tap/bucket, install, upgrade) is still present; a link to LICENSE and CHANGELOG.md is present.
